notes.title: 🍬💊 Healing Patch 1.0.1 💊🍬
notes.content:
Hello Guardians!



The first patch is here! I wanted to push this update with the solution to all problems reported so far instead of smaller ones for each one. As there were no game breaking bugs (thankfully!) reported so far I was able to do this.


Here are the fixes
Fixed the location names in the Achievement brooch panels.

Decreased difficulty for the "Hearts collected per day" achievement. All tiers now require a bit less Hearts.

Tweaked stock savings to be a little more consistent per mission. Boosted savings gain. Decreased last tier of the Stock achievement a bit.

Fixed what was causing the dose of some candies to never be "ideal" in level 1.

New screen resolutions were added in the Options.



Also, thank you again for your support by playing and giving feedback <3

notes.title: 🍭 Beta testing coming + Updates
notes.content:
Hello Guardian!

I’m so excited we are getting closer and closer to the final vision of the game!
If you’re part of the mailing list Magical Guardian’s Club you get the chance to participate in the Beta Test coming this Wednesday (April 16th). So make sure to join so you can get an exclusive Steam Key and help directly in the development!
Link: https://berrylemonadestudio.beehiiv.com/subscribe

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/77b832c060c626a566efc6e2925d3212cef6a4cd.png

That out of the way, let me show you some new things you will see in the game!

There’s a whole new Rewards + Goals system!
You will now have a magical girl brooch that will show you your goals and achievements and reward you Hearts for that. Let’s see if you can get all the achievements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/4f17f03395880bb11ebdc77360d55d252d2a310a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/02a1fa9819e3228c3ebb131d872ad5c7ea153784.png

And yes, it is shaped like a macaroon. 

Each level will now have a special goal to achieve. They’re optional but let’s see if you can rise to the challenge. I believe in you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/a8ea4f3219e96ada7dd0b6bb086fdaa46dc62927.png

Things were a bit too passive in the missions so now it is up to YOU to actually heal the citizens. Your wand detects the citizens who are ready for your magic, point your wand on them and click to heal!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/f465c77d172e9e460b8d5a2dd649a3a4953a4825.gif

There’s also a new Power Upgrade where you can let your wand do the job if you want because as you get a lot of citizens on screen things can get quite hectic!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/c185f02c54320c89ebd17df3552fd4c265e87185.png

And there are some other smaller updates too:

 Guide: some panels with more detailed information of what you learned in the tutorial with Taffy. You can consult anytime now.
 Darker screen: this specific aesthetic of the game can be a bit too bright so now there’s a brightness slider to adjust it.
 One new clothing set for this Beta (full game will have them all!)
 Some text alignment corrections were also made.


That’s it! Thank you so much for reading and I hope you are excited for the Beta!

Stay magical ✨
Love,
Erika🍋

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/ea11469758097e5c9131ebfe82c9f6a8ba384977.png

notes.title: The Demo will stay up! + Some patch updates
notes.content:
Hello pretty guardians!

Steam Next Fest week ended but the good news is in the title: I’m keeping the demo up!

One week is not enough to play all the amazing demos in the fest so now Pretty Sweet will stay up until the Beta.

I also updated the Demo fixing some issues you kindly reported:

 Fixed black screen ocurring at the start of the game for some systems.
 Fixed Reset Save button not really resetting every data.
 Fixed the Well-being score going down on the map screen. It won’t decrease anymore.


Keep up updating me with issues and giving feedback! You can do so either leaving a review on the demo page or in the Discussions forum: 

There are more improvements I’m working on regarding balancing numbers, improving game progression, quality of life and adding more content for the wardrobe.

Stay magical ✨
Love,
Erika🍋
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/ea11469758097e5c9131ebfe82c9f6a8ba384977.png
